text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Goooo for it! Satono Crowwwn!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, things are already going 
according to my winning pattern. That 
should be the case, and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Why is it so hard to run—!?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown finishes 1st!! Satono Crown 
graces the stage of the Kikuka Sho with 
glory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The title of the strongest Umamusume goes 
to the daughter of Satono! Carrying her 
rival's hopes, she has conquered the 
race!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Satono Crown!! I knew in 
my heart you could do it!!

The Kikuka Sho, a stage where stamina is 
tested to the limit. Having overcome her 
aptitude limits and emerged victorious, 
Satono Crown is showered with joyous 
cheers.
Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh! Kitasan Black--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible tenacity! Facing this 
lineup, you did well not to give up!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to your next race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much!! Thank you for 
cheering me on!!
(WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is fine. If I keep this up, I'll...――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—The harder you push yourself, the more 
dreams they'll entrust to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan.

A few days after the Kikuka Sho. Today was 
used both as a rest day and as time to 
organize information.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Kitasan Black. Her next race: the grand 
racing festival, the Arima Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Could I get her data for the 
Satsuki Sho and the Derby once more?

Using the laptop in front of me, I send 
Kitasan Black's data to Satono Crown's 
address.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I just couldn't help being curious 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...There. The analysis is in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The Satono medical and AI teams 
have joined forces to develop an app. It 
assesses an Umamusume's growth period 
through skeletal analysis—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Huh? Is this really the 
conclusion we've come to~?
choice_data_list: So, what did the analysis show?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is in the middle of a growth 
spurt—"She won't reach her peak until next 
spring or later."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"She's like a butterfly that has only just 
emerged from its cocoon. Her wings are 
still unstable. By tomorrow, she will 
surely evolve even further."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, even if we prepare for 
how Kitasan is now, there's no telling if 
we can beat tomorrow's Kitasan."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she has it. After all, she's 
"extraordinary" too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I told you before, didn't I? Kita-san's 
the type who stands right at the center of 
an era."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Meaning that the time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think, Trainer? Another 
monster of the generation is about to be 
born."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...The Twinkle Series is quite 
fascinating, isn't it?
